artifactWaiver.reason: Implementation artifacts were never emitted for the six original ADR-061 slices — the Executor briefs omitted the ADR-003 requirement, an orchestration error. The telemetry they carry (phaseRunId, executionDurationMs, toolInvocationCount, TDD red→green evidence) is unrecoverable; producing PASS records would fabricate the evidence this gate verifies, and all six Review agents independently refused to do so. All six received a full intent-review → guardrails → validate pass instead, verifying by execution rather than reading, which found three real defects now fixed on this same wave (#927 blocking Redis on the sole worker, #928 platform-wide webhook ceiling, #929 unprovable default-privileges clause). The four fix slices #926-#929 emitted proper artifacts and are NOT waived.
